sequential_dependency.intermediate: An input-dependent ordered list of cropped piece grids, each carrying its legend color, occupied nonzero-cell area, and bounding-box area.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Decode every nonzero top-row legend color left-to-right; for each color locate the unique matching body component and crop its exact bounding box.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Consume those Stage-A crops: preserve their order for the canonical setting, or stable-sort them by occupied area descending, then top-align and pack them with one blank column between pieces.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Stage B cannot choose either its items or the alternate sort keys before Stage A identifies and crops the legend-selected components. Replacing Stage A's occupied-area measurements with bbox areas, or reversing its legend order, changes protected-Racket outputs on the retained cases.
